notes.title: Magicbook AutoBattler: Contract - Summer Sale historic low! Workshop now live
notes.content:
Update Details:

*   One-Click Synthesis:
    Thanks to player feedback, we've implemented a One-Click Synthesis feature.

[b]*   Steam Workshop:
    In this update, we've added Workshop support! This is an incredibly fun Steam feature that allows you to customize weapons to your liking, even without coding knowledge. Here's how to get started:
    1.  In your Steam Library, select Magicbook AutoBattler: Contract.
    2.  Click on the 'Workshop' tab.
    3.  Under player-created weapons, click "Learn More".
    4.  You can follow our guide to create your own, or directly apply the templates we provide.[/b]

*   Leaderboards:
    Leaderboards are now live! Players can now compete for rankings in Endless Mode or Endless Challenge Mode. (Note: Weapons created in the Workshop are not eligible for leaderboard rankings).

*   Weapon Adjustments: (Values for all rarities have been adjusted; only Red quality stats are listed here)
    *   Extreme Orb: Upon casting a skill, increases own Attack Speed by 10% (stacks up to 50%). While the skill is active, normal attacks become double strikes. Deals 30% additional damage to enemies under the "Frost" status. Hitting a target with "Frost" deals additional Magic Damage equal to 120% of INT in a small area around the target.
    *   Frost Staff: Summons ice crystals to deal Magic Damage equal to 150% of INT to 17 random enemies and applies 1 stack of "Frost". If the target reaches max "Frost" stacks, it clears all stacks and applies the "Frozen" status for 3 seconds. Applies 1 stack of "Frost" to 17 random enemies at the start of battle.
    *   Cursed Blade: Attacks the nearest enemy twice. Each attack has a 50% chance to apply "Curse". Skill: Deals Physical Damage equal to 400% of AGI to the 7 furthest enemies and applies "Curse". When casting the skill, if the target is Poisoned, immediately stuns them for 2 seconds.
    *   Ancient Bone Bow: Attacks the single furthest enemy. Each attack has a 10% chance to apply "Poison". Piercing Eye: Fires 3 arrows at the furthest target, dealing 3 hits of Physical Damage (each equal to 80% of AGI). Each arrow applies 1 stack of "Poison".

*   New Weapon:
    *   Dragonbreath Greatsword: Attacks a single close-range enemy. Flame Breath: Deals Physical Damage equal to 400% of STR to all enemies and applies 5 stacks of "Burning".

*   New Boss Sets:
    *   Sharknado Set Effect: When using normal attacks or skills, if the target has "Burning", applies an additional 5 stacks of "Burning". If the target has "Poison", applies an additional 7 stacks of "Poison".
    *   Magma Core Set Effect: Every 10 seconds, gains a Shield equal to 500% of INT. While this Shield is active, Magic Damage dealt is increased by 15%.
    *   Void Lord Set Effect: Every 2 skill casts, applies a Weaken debuff to enemies. Each Weaken stack reduces the target's Physical and Magic Damage by 8% (stacks up to 5 times).
    *   Vile Alchemist Set Effect: Increases AGI by 25%. When casting a skill, deals additional damage equal to {Agility} * 3 to the skill's target.
    *   Calamity Breath Set Effect: Gains 10% Lifesteal. Each time a skill is cast, deals AoE damage equal to {Strength} * 1.5 to the target.

*   Other Updates:
    1.  In Endless Mode / Endless Challenge Mode, a new event specifically for obtaining Boss Sets has been added. It first appears at Stage 100, and reappears every 50 stages thereafter.
    2.  In Challenge Mode, the types of buffs obtainable by both allies and enemies have been modified, resolving an issue where Defense values could overflow.
    3.  Monster experience now scales with the stage level.
    4.  High-level Red equipment now correctly provides increasing amounts of materials when dismantled or obtained.

*   Bug Fixes:
    Fixed an issue where the attribute bonuses from some characters' passive skills were not taking effect.

notes.title: A brand new version is coming! Come and experience it!
notes.content:
Dear Players,
This update brings a comprehensive optimization of core mechanics and removes multiple growth restrictions, offering you a more liberated gaming experience.  

[b]System Rework – Treasure Synergy 2.0[/b]

[b]New Energy Mechanism [/b]
Starting Energy: 20 points (freely distributable for synergy effects)  
Growth Potential: Expandable up to 175 energy by upgrading your Spellbook  
Strategic Upgrade: Freely combine synergies within the energy limit  

[b]Synergy Effect Adjustments[/b]
Optimized trigger conditions and effect ranges for certain synergies  

[b]Growth System Revamp[/b] 
Character Level Adjustments
Level cap removed—characters can now level up infinitely  

[b]Red Equipment Enhancement Changes[/b]  
Red-tier equipment can now be enhanced infinitely  
Added the ability to enhance red equipment using orange materials  
Red+1 equipment may appear in shops after reaching Shop Level 11  

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b] 
In standard Endless Mode, weapons can be swapped every 90 stages  

We look forward to your experience in the new version!  

---------------------------------------------   
[b]Update Highlights[/b]
- Treasure Synergy system now features an energy mechanism  
- Character levels and equipment enhancements have no upper limit  
- Endless Mode adds weapon-swapping functionality

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
Dear Players,
We have made extensive updates to the game content. Some of the new features are still being refined, and we welcome any feedback or suggestions you may have. Your support is our driving force for continuous improvement! Here are the details of this update:

New Features
-Shortcut Functionality: Customizable via Settings > Shortcuts.
-Team Interface: Added the "Mini Blacksmith" feature.
-Weapon Reselection: In Endless Challenge mode, players can reselect their weapon every 90 levels.
-Endless BOSS Challenge: Reintroduced BOSS challenge gameplay in Endless mode.
-Character Details in Battle: During combat, clicking on the character frame at the bottom allows you to quickly switch and view detailed attribute information of different characters (ongoing optimization).
-Direct Equipment Sale: Players can now directly sell equipment they are wearing in the team interface.

New Weapons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/48c69c70865cd93038e4bee2143db8d7bdaab72c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/458e990bd7e7ed2f7faea11719d824048901e9db.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/d89db9ecb1956a5bd79d8ee2c529254614f02c01.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/0671330c91e727ff1577cbea6913564369af8a9b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/91e2ceba9cd5de9fd99a8b8cebfb37299300ccf6.png[/img]

New Artifacts
-Hatred's Arrow: Taunts enemies for 5 seconds at the start of the battle. Each skill release also taunts enemies for 5 seconds.
-Blazing Pendant: Adds 2 layers of Burn to the target when a skill is used. If the target has more than 5 layers of Burn, an additional layer of Burn is added.
-Fire Crystal Core: Every two skill releases, randomly adds 2 layers of Burn to 5 characters. When the target is in the Burn state, adds 1 layer of Melt Armor.

New Artifact Synergies
-Flame's Will: Gain permanent buffs when attacking. If the target's Burn layers > 10, gain 15% increased damage; > 20 layers, increase energy recovery by 10% and attack speed by 30%; > 30 layers, add an additional 10 layers of Burn.

New Buff Effects
-Wind Shield: While active, reduces physical damage taken by 25%.

Talent Adjustments
-Adjusted the buff effects granted by global talents after satisfying class bonds.

Rogue Bond Adjustments:
-Tier 1: Increased physical damage reduction and skill recovery for Rogues.
-Tier 2:
Rogues: Every 5 seconds, the next regular attack adds 1 layer of Poison to the target and surrounding enemies.
Rogues: Every 5 seconds, the next regular attack adds 1 layer of Burn to the target and surrounding enemies.
-Tier 5:
Rogues: When performing a regular attack, if the target has Poison, an additional layer of Weakness is added.
Rogues: When using a skill, if the target has Burn, an additional 3 layers of Burn are added.
-Tier 7:
All Classes: When using a skill, immediately settle the abnormal damage of the current layers of Burn and Poison on the target.
All Classes: Every 10 seconds, double the layers of Burn and Poison on all enemy units.

Artifact Synergy Adjustments:
-Ice Power Synergy: Every two skill releases grant a "Deep Freeze" effect. When the character's Ice Energy reaches 20 layers and this effect is present, it immediately consumes the "Deep Freeze" effect, clears all Ice Energy, and deals 10% of the maximum health as reflective damage to 7 random enemies.

Debuff Adjustments:
-Weakness: (Max 10 stacks) Each stack reduces the target's Physical Damage, Magic Damage, and Healing Effect by 5%, up to 50%. If Weakness reaches 10 stacks, applies "​​Healing Block​​" to the target. Affected units have reduced size.
-Poison: (Infinite stacks) Deals 50 DoT per 1s. Each stack reduces 0.5% STR/AGI/INT (max -50%). Stacking refreshes duration.
-Armor Melt: (Max 10 stacks) Each stack increases damage taken by 10% (max +100%).
-Burn: (Infinite stacks) 6s duration. Deals 200 DoT every 3s. Stacking refreshes duration.

Artifact Effect Adjustments:
-Kiss of the Serpent Necklace: Regular attacks have a 30% chance to add 2 layers of Poison to 5 random enemies.
-Emerald Serpent: Regular attacks have a 20% chance to add 1 layer of Poison to the target. Every 5 seconds, the next regular attack will definitely add 1 layer of Weakness.
-Heart of Poison Healing: Increases maximum health by 20%. When a regular attack targets a Weakness unit, there is a 30% chance to add 1 layer of Frost to the target and surrounding units.
-Orb of Plague: Increases physical damage by 10%. When performing a regular attack, if the target's Poison layers > 3, add 1 layer of Weakness. If the target's Weakness layers > 1, add 1 layer of Frost.
-Whisper of the Wind Necklace: Increases attack speed by 30%. When performing a regular attack, if the target has Frost, there is a 30% chance to add 2 layers of Poison to the target and surrounding units. If the target's Poison layers > 10, there is a 50% chance to add 1 layer of Wind Shield to yourself and surrounding teammates for 8 seconds.
-Windchaser's Quiver: Increases agility by 15%. Regular attacks have a 50% chance to add 1 layer of Wind Energy to yourself and a 25% chance to add 1 layer of Wind Energy to nearby teammates. When your Wind Energy layers reach 10, gain the Windstride state.
-Frost-Plague Crystal: When taking damage, if the artifact carrier is in the Ice Energy state, add 1 layer of Poison to the source of damage.
-Undying Flame: Regular attacks have a 20% chance to apply Burn. Every 5 seconds in combat, the next regular attack will definitely cause a Melt Armor effect.
-Guardian of Fire Spirit Necklace: When healing teammates, the teammate's next regular attack will apply 1 layer of Burn to the target. If the target already has Burn, an additional 2 layers of Burn are added.
-Flame's Pulse: Regular attacks have a 60% chance to apply Blaze to yourself and a 20% chance to apply Blaze to teammates within range.
-Flame Emblem: Every 5 regular attacks, apply 1 layer of Burn to 5 random enemies. When performing a regular attack, if the target is in the Burn state, add 1 layer of Melt Armor.

Leader Blessing Adjustments:
-Soul of Fire: After entering the battle, summon the remnant of the Fire Lord to attack all enemies, causing 5% of their maximum health as damage and adding 10 layers of Burn.
-Soul of Poison : After entering the battle, summon the remnant of the Death Knight to charge, causing 7% of the enemies' maximum health as damage and adding 20 layers of Poison.

Weapon Adjustments:
-Adjusted the skill effects of Venomous Fang and Burning Dagger.

Endless Mode Adjustments:
-Adjusted the logic of BUFF generation in Endless Challenge mode to make it easier for players to obtain effective BUFFs.

Interface Optimization:
-Optimized the appearance of the BUFF selection UI and other parts of the UI in Endless Challenge mode.

Fixes:
-Fixed the issue where monsters occasionally move behind the player's character during combat.
-Fixed the issue where some set attributes were lost.
-Fixed the issue where passive percentage increases for characters did not take effect.
-Fixed the issue where the "Two Generals" leader blessing did not take effect.
-Fixed the issue where the effects of "Plague Serum" and "Ice Source Ring" were not correctly displayed in the character attribute interface.
-Fixed the issue where rewards were abnormally obtained in some events.
-Fixed the issue where prohibited artifacts were displayed in Endless Hardcore mode.
-Fixed some localized language text (ongoing optimization).

notes.title: KEY activation & old archive inheritance
notes.content:
About KEY and activation:
If you have purchased "Magic Book Auto Chess", you can send an email to mbab123@163.com and attach a screenshot. (For detailed operation steps, please see the "Magic Book Auto Chess" old player compensation KEY announcement)
After receiving the key, you can follow the steps below to activate it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/7f102bfb2d359341834d2733ef91d1782c20a561.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/b67266ee04fc7ee56b28de69b45c283ea854b02e.png[/img]

About how to inherit the old version of the archive:
Automatic transfer: If the player's old archive exists, the archive will be automatically transferred when the game is started for the first time. If the automatic transfer does not occur after the game is started, the archive can be transferred manually.
Manual transfer:
1. Open the archive folder in the archive interface and enter the new archive folder path.
2. Click to enter the ChinaChongQingJuXiangStudio file hierarchy, which contains two folders: the old archive (Spellbook Auto Chess) and the new archive (Spellbook Auto Chess: Contract).
3. Copy and paste all the files in the old archive folder to replace all the files in the new archive folder.
4. Restart the game to view.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/bee0dfe10ef8a86e84c747fcf12f286830d31957.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506581/93534d4d5c2a69c29998cfee60af0b559f6b97c0.png[/img]]
